name: Víctor Gutiérrez García
role: PhD student in computer vision at GAPS-UPM

home.bio: I am a PhD student in the Signal Processing Applications Group ([GAPS-UPM](https://www.gaps.ssr.upm.es/)) at Universidad Politécnica de Madrid, advised by Dr. José Luis Blanco Murillo. My research focuses on efficient unsupervised image segmentation algorithms.
home.note: I received an MSc in Signal Processing and Machine Learning in 2025 and a BSc in Telecommunications Engineering in 2024 from UPM. Before starting my PhD, I worked on stockpile volume estimation for the European project DigiEcoQuarry. Previously I developed radar tracking algorithms and simulations at Advanced Radar Technologies.

publications.title: PANC: Prior-Aware Normalized Cut via Anchor-Augmented Token Graphs
publications.authors: Juan Gutiérrez, Victor Gutiérrez-García, and José Luis Blanco-Murillo
publications.description: A training-free method for consistent, user-steerable segmentation from self-supervised ViT patches. PANC connects labeled prior tokens to foreground and background anchors, guiding normalized-cut partitions while preserving global spectral structure.

publications.title: Does AI Assistance Preserve or Collapse Disagreement? A Study of Pre-Annotations in Ambiguous Video Labeling
publications.authors: Juan Gutiérrez, Victor Gutiérrez-García, and José Luis Blanco-Murillo
publications.venue: Pluralistic Alignment Workshop at ICML 2026, Seoul, South Korea
publications.description: A controlled pilot study of AI-assisted video annotation with 18 annotators and 180 sessions. Pre-annotations reduced mean annotation time by 23.11% and increased consistency and latent-space standardization, while semantic-label entropy changed little; the results leave open whether meaningful disagreement is preserved.
